inputs.question: Is proposed work adjacent to or encroaching into the right-of-way (ROW) identified and labeled on this site plan? Look for labels identifying ROW work such as sidewalk construction, ROW dedications, utility work in ROW, or other improvements within or adjacent to the ROW boundaries.
inputs.regionHint: Along the street frontages where ROW improvements are proposed
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking whether ROW work is identified and labeled on the site plan—a drawing-element annotation check (presence of labels and their placement relative to ROW boundaries), not a measurement or document-presence task.

applicableChecklistItems.checklist_deficiency_text: Proposed work adjacent to or encroaching into ROW not identified and labeled (SVC-02)

result.answerText: Yes, there is proposed work adjacent to and encroaching into the right-of-way (ROW). The plan shows proposed curb and gutter, planting zones, ADA ramps (Keynote 12), and curb inlets (Keynote 3) along the labeled 'COLLIER STREET (R.O.W. VARIES)'.

evidence.description: Proposed work along the Collier Street ROW, including curb and gutter, planting zones, and ADA ramps.

result.reasoning: The drawing explicitly labels 'COLLIER STREET (R.O.W. VARIES)' along the northern frontage. Immediately adjacent to and within this ROW, there are clear indications of proposed improvements, such as the 'PROPOSED CURB AND GUTTER' (identified by the linetype in the legend), planting zones, and keynoted features like proposed ADA ramps and curb inlets.
